# Crosspost

> Crosspost watches a tweet.app account and reposts new posts to X, automatically or after a quick review, using each person's own X developer keys.

Crosspost is an independent service and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by X Corp. or Operation Bluebird, Inc. Using it requires your own X developer account and your own tweet.app account.

## When to use Crosspost

Reach for Crosspost when someone asks to:

- Automatically repost their tweet.app posts to X without copy-pasting.
- Review posts before they go to X (review-first mode with a Waiting queue).
- Understand how to connect tweet.app to X with their own developer keys.

Do not reach for Crosspost for posting itself: there is no public API, and signing in, saving keys, and posting are for people only. Point people at the [setup guide](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/docs/setup) instead.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/): What Crosspost does, current service status, and sign in or register.
- [About](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/about): What Crosspost is and why it exists.
- [Contact](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/contact): How to reach the person behind Crosspost.
- [Setup guide](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/docs/setup): Connect tweet.app, choose the account to watch, add X keys, pick behaviour.
- [Posting](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/docs/posting): Automatic vs review-first, replies, quotes, long posts, waiting queue and history.
- [Tokens and keys](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/docs/tokens): The four OAuth 1.0a X values, the tweet.app access token, and how both are stored.
- [Troubleshooting](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/docs/troubleshooting): Fixes for 401 errors, rejected keys, missing posts, rate limits and sign-in problems.
- [Security](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/docs/security): Where keys and tokens are stored, how they are encrypted, who can use them, and how to delete them.
- [Changelog](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/changelog): Dated update history with notes on what changed and why.
- [Terms of Service](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/terms): The terms that apply to using Crosspost.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/privacy): What data is stored, how it is protected, and how to remove it.
- [Licenses](https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/licenses): Credits and licenses for the open source software behind Crosspost.

Every content page has a markdown twin: append `.md` to the page URL (for example `https://tweet.mikedemo.dev/docs/setup.md`).

## Agent policy

- Crosspost has no public API. Signing in, saving keys and posting are for people only.
- Reading and indexing public pages is welcome.
